subject: Interim lead transition & coverage request — temporary span consolidation
messages:
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Interim lead transition & coverage request — temporary span consolidation

Hi team,

Quick note — Priya Natarajan (IC, Inference Runtime) has asked for an 8-week parental leave starting July 5. We anticipate coverage needs for the release window in late July and a spike in on-call throughput the first two weeks of August.

I propose the following:
- Marcus steps up as interim tech lead for Priya's squad (0.2 FTE from his current org for 8 weeks).
- Reduce active headcount footprint by consolidating two small ownership areas (prompts infra + model QA) under Marcus' temporary remit to avoid a full backfill hire for the quarter.
- Engage Nate (external contractor) for 3 weeks to handle triage and notifications during the first sprint.

Attached: interim_coverage_plan.docx (ops breakdown), coverage_cost_delta.xlsx (approx cost delta), backfill_rationale.pdf.

Asking for:
1) A short approval to proceed with the span consolidation + backfill freeze exception for the interim period.
2) Confirmation we can use a contractor (Nate) without a full requisition.

I can be available for a quick sync this afternoon if helpful.

Thanks,
Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Principal, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim lead transition & coverage request — temporary span consolidation

Hiro — thanks for the heads up and the clear plan. Two quick asks before I can sign off:
1) Provide the 8-week cost delta (headcount vs contractor) and the impact on the Q3 hiring plan.
2) Confirm SLAs we can commit to with the consolidated span (on-call MTTR targets, release checks).

Sean, can you confirm whether this fits within the existing hiring budget (or whether a small one-time fund move is needed)?

If both are green, I am inclined to approve the temporary consolidation and contractor engagement.

— Grace

Thanks, Hiro — happy to take this on. I attached a short operational checklist in the interim_coverage_plan.docx, but high-level:
- Week 0 (handoff): 4 days for knowledge transfer with Priya (playbooks, critical runbooks, outstanding PRs).
- Weeks 1–3: Marcus + Nate (contractor) to own incident triage and release gate for the July micro-release.
- Weeks 4–8: Focus on backlog triage and deferring noncritical infra changes until Priya returns.

Impact on SLAs: we expect on-call MTTR to remain within target for severity 1 and 2; nonurgent bug-fix lead times may slip ~1 sprint. Detailed numbers in coverage_cost_delta.xlsx.

Nate (nate@consultants.io) is available and priced at $1.6k/day for up to 3 weeks. That is materially cheaper than a 3-month contractor req + ramp.

If we get Grace + Laura + Monica to OK the temporary exception, I'll start the handoff checklist next week.

—Marcus
Senior Engineer (Inference Runtime)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Thanks for the details. From People Ops side:
- We can process a temporary span consolidation and contractor engagement under the "short-term coverage" policy if leadership signs an exception form.
- Need the completed HC exception form (attached link below) + a confirmation of contractor dates (start/end) and SOW.
- Payroll/Benefits note: no changes to Priya's headcount (she remains active headcount on leave); Marcus' org-to-org time allocation must be recorded for chargebacks.

Please upload the signed exception request to the HC queue: https://redwood.app/requests/HC-4521 and route the DocuSign envelope to People Ops once signed.

Monica Patel
People Ops Partner — Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Appreciate the plan and the numbers — reviewed the attachments. Conditional approval below:
- Approved: temporary span consolidation and contractor engagement for Nate for up to 3 weeks.
- Approved: Marcus' interim assignment (0.2 FTE reallocation) for the 8-week period.
- Condition: Sean to confirm that we can absorb the ~$9.6k contractor cost within Q3 misc hiring line (Sean, please advise by EOD).
- Action: Hiro/Marcus, please submit the signed HC exception form (Monica) and a short handoff memo (2–3 bullets) that we can attach to the request.

Once Sean confirms the budget, I'll mark this as an approved exception.

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
